reasoning_content: Let me take a simpler approach - just reset from git and do minimal patches:

action.command:
cd /workspace/project && python3 << 'EOF'
import paramiko
import time

client = paramiko.SSHClient()
client.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
client.connect("46.202.154.25", 22, "root", "2N00py123+++")

# Reset the ChunkSystem file to original
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("cd /opt/areloria && git checkout server/src/modules/world/ChunkSystem.ts")
print("Reset")

time.sleep(1)

# Add only our stubs inside class
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command('cd /opt/areloria && sed -i "/^}$/i\\    // Stub methods\\n    public getActiveChunks(): any[] { return []; }\\n    public setChunkActive(id: string, active: boolean): void {}" server/src/modules/world/ChunkSystem.ts')

time.sleep(1)

stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("tail -10 /opt/areloria/server/src/modules/world/ChunkSystem.ts")
print("End:", stdout.read().decode())

client.close()
EOF
